body.name: Outer-set and set-of-sets inversion
body.construction: \(C_n=\bigcup_{q'\in R_n\cap\overline{\mathcal Q}}S(q')\), \(\mathcal H_n=\{S(q'):q'\in R_n\cap\overline{\mathcal Q}\}\); if \(R_n\cap\overline{\mathcal Q}=\varnothing\), set \(C_n=[y_1,y_K]^L\) and let \(\mathcal H_n\) contain every nonempty compact subset of \([y_1,y_K]^L\)
